name: go-geom-transactional-geometry-mutation-journals
instr:
go-geom cannot synchronously observe, veto, or atomically group mutations to Point, LineString, Polygon, MultiPoint, MultiLineString, MultiPolygon, and GeometryCollection values.

Report subscribed mutations synchronously and in order with geometry identity, MutationKind, ComponentPath, and BatchID, without exposing mutable coordinate storage. Closing a Subscription stops only its delivery. MutationVeto returns MutationRejectedError and atomically restores coordinates, topology, layout, SRID, and representation metadata.

Batches publish nothing until completion, then publish ordered records and exactly one MutationBatchCommitted or MutationBatchRolledBack outcome. Nested batches share this lifecycle. Closed MutationBatch operations fail without effects. MutationTopology covers structural changes; MutationCoordinates, MutationLayout, MutationSRID, and MutationSwap distinguish other operations.

Preserve every concrete geometry's representation semantics across commit, veto, and rollback: empty values, stride and layout validation, repeated or cumulative ends, member boundaries, aliases, and nested heterogeneous topology. Records distinguish structural member changes even without added flat coordinates. TransformInPlaceWithMutations recursively changes coordinates in one traversal-ordered atomic batch and reverses every change on error.
